title: Lower bounds for some value sets over finite fields: incidence geometry and Bourgain's group expansion theorem
summary: We develop two transition principles for lower-bounding value sets generated by structured sequences over prime fields. A reciprocal-affine family with $M$ internal transitions and bounded quotient multiplicity has image size $\gg \min{M,p}^{8/15}$. This recovers the factorial-residue bound and yields the same exponent for arithmetic Pochhammer products, Gaussian $q$-factorials, derangement numbers, and the numbers of ordered subsets.
